title: A School Field Trip
subtitle: 全真模拟第 1 题 · 计划与行程类 · 班级实地考察计划
body: Attention, boys and girls! I'd like to tell you about our school field trip this Friday. We are going to visit the City Agricultural Park. Please meet at the school gate at 8:00 a.m., and we will go there by school bus. It takes about forty minutes. In the morning, a local farmer will show us around the greenhouses and teach us how different vegetables grow. After that, we can pick fresh strawberries by ourselves. At noon, we will cook a simple lunch together using fresh vegetables from the farm. In the afternoon, we will play a fun team game on the grass and return to school at 3:30 p.m. Please remember to wear comfortable sports shoes and bring your own water bottle and a sun hat.
opening: Hello, everyone. Here is the plan for our school field trip this Friday.
slots:
# A School Field Trip
Time and place: this Friday; the City Agricultural Park; meet at the school gate at 8:00 a.m.
How to get there: by school bus, about forty minutes
Morning activities: a farmer shows us the greenhouses and how vegetables grow; pick fresh strawberries
Afternoon activities: play a team game on the grass; return to school at 3:30 p.m.
Things to prepare: wear comfortable sports shoes; bring a water bottle and a sun hat
referenceRetell:
【基础稳妥版】Hello, everyone. Here is the plan for our school field trip this Friday. We will visit the City Agricultural Park. We will meet at the school gate at 8:00 a.m. and take the school bus there. In the morning, we will learn how vegetables grow and pick fresh strawberries. At noon, we will cook lunch together. In the afternoon, we will play a team game on the grass and come back to school at 3:30 p.m. Finally, we should wear sports shoes and bring a water bottle and a sun hat.

【高分进阶版】Hello, everyone. Here is the plan for our school field trip this Friday. We are going to visit the City Agricultural Park. First, we'll meet at the school gate at 8:00 a.m. and go there by school bus. In the morning, a farmer will teach us how vegetables grow, and then we can pick fresh strawberries. At noon, we'll cook lunch together with farm vegetables. In the afternoon, we'll play a fun team game on the grass before returning to school at 3:30 p.m. Please remember to wear comfortable sports shoes and bring a water bottle as well as a sun hat.

title: A Visit to the City Zoo
subtitle: 全真模拟第 2 题 · 计划与行程类 · 市动物园参观行程
body: Good morning, class! Next Monday, we are going to visit the City Zoo. We will leave school at 8:30 in the morning by school bus. When we arrive at the zoo, we will go to see the giant pandas first because they are most active in the morning. Then, at 10:30, we will walk to the Bird World to watch different kinds of colourful birds. At 12 o'clock, we'll have a picnic lunch together on the central lawn. In the afternoon, at 1:30, a zoo keeper will give us a short talk about animal protection in the Science Hall. While visiting, please do not make loud noises or feed the animals with your own food. Also, don't forget to bring enough drinking water and an umbrella.
opening: I'd like to tell you about our visit to the City Zoo next Monday.

Morning route: see the giant pandas first; go to the Bird World at 10:30
Lunch: a picnic lunch on the central lawn at 12:00
Afternoon activity: a zoo keeper gives a talk about animal protection in the Science Hall at 1:30
Rules and things to bring: no loud noises; don't feed the animals our own food; bring drinking water and an umbrella

title: Saturday Plan with Foreign Friend
subtitle: 全真模拟第 3 题 · 计划与行程类 · 周六家庭出游计划
body: Hi, Peter! Welcome to Beijing. I've made a wonderful plan for us this Saturday. At 9:00 in the morning, we will take the subway to Beihai Park. The weather will be sunny, so we can climb the White Tower and row a boat on the lake. At 12:00, I'll take you to a famous traditional restaurant for lunch, and we'll try delicious Beijing Roast Duck there. In the afternoon, at about 2:30, we are going to visit the Capital Museum. You can see many ancient artworks and learn about the long history of Beijing. In the evening, at 6:30, we will take a walk along Qianmen Street, where you can buy some nice postcards and gifts for your family. I'm sure we'll have a great time!

Lunch: Beijing Roast Duck at a famous traditional restaurant at 12:00
Afternoon: visit the Capital Museum at 2:30; see ancient artworks and learn Beijing's history
Evening: walk along Qianmen Street at 6:30; buy postcards and gifts

title: Community Volunteer Day
subtitle: 全真模拟第 4 题 · 计划与行程类 · 寒假社区志愿服务安排
body: Hello, everyone! This Sunday, our class will take part in the Community Volunteer Day. We will meet at the gate of the Community Service Center at 9:00 in the morning. There will be two groups. Group One will go to the community park to clean the benches and pick up litter on the ground. Group Two will visit the old people in the community and teach them how to use smartphones to shop online and make video calls. At noon, the community center will provide free lunch for us. At 2:00 in the afternoon, all volunteers will gather in the meeting room to share our feelings and experiences. Please remember to wear your red volunteer vest on that day.

title: Summer English Camp
subtitle: 全真模拟第 5 题 · 计划与行程类 · 暑期英语夏令营日程
body: Boys and girls, would you like to improve your spoken English this summer? Come and join our Summer English Camp! The camp will run for a week, from July 10th to July 16th, at the Youth Activity Center. Every morning, foreign teachers will teach you English speaking skills and guide you to act out short English plays. In the afternoon, you can take part in different sports, such as playing frisbee, playing basketball, or swimming in the indoor pool. In the evening, we will watch classic English movies together, and on the last night, there will be a big talent show. If you want to join, please fill in the application form on our school website before June 25th.

title: School Music Competition
subtitle: 全真模拟第 6 题 · 活动通知与比赛类 · 校园音乐比赛通知
body: Good afternoon, everyone! I have some exciting news for music lovers. Our school is going to hold the annual School Music Competition this month. Any junior high school student in our school can take part in it. You can choose to sing a song, or play a musical instrument such as the piano, the guitar, or traditional Chinese instruments like the erhu. To enter the competition, please record a three-minute video of your performance and send it to your music teacher before next Friday. The best ten performers will enter the final competition in the school hall on December 28th. The winners will get two free tickets to the City New Year Concert!

title: Welcoming Party for New Students
subtitle: 全真模拟第 7 题 · 活动通知与比赛类 · 新生欢迎派对安排
body: Hello, everyone! Welcome to our school. To help our Grade Seven students feel at home, we are going to hold a welcoming party for new students. The party will take place in the school main hall. It will begin at half past six next Monday afternoon. All the teachers as well as students from different grades are going to attend it. title: My Dream Community Library
subtitle: 全真模拟第 11 题 · 介绍与描述类 · 我心目中的理想社区图书馆
body: I would like to talk about my dream community library. My dream library is not very huge, but it is bright, quiet, and surrounded by green trees and colourful flowers. It opens from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. every day, so students and workers can visit it easily. Inside the library, besides thousands of paper books, there is an e-book zone with fast computers and a warm picture book corner for young children. On weekends, the library holds free reading sharing meetings and invites famous writers to give talks. At noon, readers can also buy tea and sandwiches in a small café on the first floor. The librarians there are all helpful and patient, and the readers are quiet and polite.

title: A Warm Family Moment
subtitle: 全真模拟第 12 题 · 介绍与描述类 · 难忘的家庭温馨时刻
body: Family moments always bring us warmth and happiness. Today I'd like to share a warm family moment with you. It happened last Sunday evening, which was my grandma's seventieth birthday. Our whole family got together at my grandparents' house. Before dinner, everyone was busy preparing surprises in the kitchen. My father cooked a big bowl of long-life noodles, and my mother baked a sweet strawberry cake. As for me, I drew a colourful family picture and wrote my best wishes on the back. After dinner, we sat around the sofa, looked at old family photos, and listened to Grandma tell stories about her youth. Seeing the big smile on Grandma's face, I felt really warm, happy, and grateful for the love in my family.

title: The School Gardening Club
subtitle: 全真模拟第 13 题 · 介绍与描述类 · 我最喜爱的学校社团
body: Hello, everyone! Let me introduce our School Gardening Club to you. The club was started two years ago by our biology teacher, and now it has 35 members from all three grades. We meet every Tuesday and Friday after school, from 4:30 to 5:30, on the school roof garden. In the club, each small group looks after a piece of land. We plant tomatoes, carrots, and bright sunflowers in spring. Every week, we water the plants, pull out weeds, and take notes on how tall they grow. When autumn comes, we harvest the fresh vegetables and share them with our school kitchen so everyone can taste them. Students love the club because it helps us relax after busy study and teaches us useful life skills.

title: My Role Model — Uncle Wang
subtitle: 全真模拟第 14 题 · 介绍与描述类 · 我的榜样人物介绍
body: Everyone has a role model in their heart. Today I'd like to talk about my role model, Uncle Wang. He is my neighbor and has worked as a community doctor for fifteen years. He is 45 years old, tall and thin, and always wears a pair of glasses. Uncle Wang is very kind, patient, and hardworking. Every day at the clinic, he examines sick people carefully and gives them health advice. Even on weekends, he often visits old patients who cannot walk easily at their homes. Last winter, when I had a high fever late at night, he came to my home right away and looked after me until I felt better. From Uncle Wang, I have learned to be a warm-hearted person and work hard to help people in need.

title: Chinese Paper Cutting
subtitle: 全真模拟第 15 题 · 介绍与描述类 · 中国传统民间艺术介绍
body: Hello, everyone! Today I'd like to introduce a famous traditional art form — Chinese paper cutting. It has a long history of more than 1,500 years in China. Making paper cuttings does not need expensive materials. People only use a piece of red paper and a pair of sharp scissors or a small knife. By folding and cutting the paper carefully, artists can create many lively shapes, such as beautiful flowers, cute animals like fish and the twelve zodiac animals, and the Chinese character 'Fu'. During the Spring Festival and weddings, people love to put red paper cuttings on windows, doors, and walls. In Chinese culture, they stand for good luck, happiness, and best wishes for a new year.

title: How to Protect Our Eyesight
subtitle: 全真模拟第 16 题 · 规则、建议与方法类 · 科学保护视力的建议
body: Good afternoon, students! Eyes are the windows to our mind, so here is some useful advice on how to protect our eyesight. First, we should develop good reading habits. When we read or write, we must sit straight and keep the book about 30 centimeters away from our eyes. Never read in bed or in dim light. Second, control our screen time. After using a computer or phone for 40 minutes, we should rest our eyes for 10 minutes by looking at green trees far away. Third, try to do at least one hour of outdoor sports every day, because natural sunlight is very helpful for eye health. Finally, eat more vegetables and fruit like carrots and blueberries, and get at least eight hours of sleep every night.

title: Tips on Taking Good English Notes
subtitle: 全真模拟第 17 题 · 规则、建议与方法类 · 高效记英语笔记的方法
body: Hi, everyone! Taking good notes can help us learn English much better. Today I'd like to share some tips on taking good English notes. First, before class, prepare a special notebook and draw a line to divide each page into two columns—one wide column for class notes and a narrow one for your questions. Also, preview the new lesson briefly. Second, during class, don't try to write down every word the teacher says. Instead, focus on new phrases, grammar rules, and typical examples. Third, use simple symbols like stars and arrows, and use two different pen colors to highlight important points. Finally, review and tidy up your notes within 24 hours after class, and try to write your own example sentences.

title: Home Safety Rules
subtitle: 全真模拟第 18 题 · 规则、建议与方法类 · 居家消防与用电安全守则
body: Boys and girls, staying safe at home is very important, especially when you are home alone. Here are some important rules for keeping safe at home. First, be careful with electricity. Never touch electrical switches with wet hands, and remember to unplug phone chargers after using them. Second, pay attention to kitchen safety. Always turn off the gas right after cooking, and keep paper towels and cloth away from the stove. Third, when someone knocks on the door, look through the peephole first and never open the door to strangers if your parents are not at home. Finally, in case of fire or danger, stay calm, call 119 or 110 at once, and ask your parents or trusted neighbors for help.

title: Rules in the Science Lab
subtitle: 全真模拟第 19 题 · 规则、建议与方法类 · 科学实验室使用规定
body: Welcome to our chemistry class! Before we start our lesson, please remember the rules in the science lab. First, before entering the lab, please arrive on time. If you have long hair, tie it back, and everyone must wear a white lab coat and safety glasses. Second, during the experiment, listen to the teacher's instructions carefully at every step. Never touch, taste, or smell any chemicals directly. Third, for your safety, do not bring any food, snacks, or drinks into the laboratory. Finally, after the experiment is over, put all the bottles back in place, clean your desk, turn off the water tap and power, and wash your hands carefully with soap before leaving.

title: Ways to Live a Green Life at School
subtitle: 全真模拟第 20 题 · 规则、建议与方法类 · 绿色低碳校园生活倡议
body: Hello, everyone! Protecting the environment starts with small actions around us. Today I'd like to share some ways to live a green life at school. First, we should save energy and water. Always turn off the lights, fans, and classroom computer when the last person leaves the room, and turn off the tap right after washing hands. Second, save paper in our daily study. We can write on both sides of the paper and pass our clean old textbooks to younger students. Third, reduce waste in the dining hall. Take only as much food as we can finish, clean our plates, and use cloth bags instead of plastic bags. Finally, choose green ways to travel, such as walking, riding a bike, or taking the bus to school.
